clauses.statement: The receipt conforms to bellbook-core-v1, and if it declares that profile the declaration names the evaluated table.
signature_required_kinds includes Candidate, Evaluation, Selection, Retraction, and Requirement.
author_keys pins every actor that authored an accepted Candidate, Evaluation, Selection, Retraction, or Requirement.
Every evaluation Used by an accepted Selection with outcome Selected carries the schema bellbook.evaluation.attested.v1.
